name: unifpdf
expr: y_d = unifpdf(0.5); y_d0 = unifpdf(0); y_d1 = unifpdf(1); y_dlo = unifpdf(-0.1); y_dhi = unifpdf(1.1); y_s = unifpdf(0.5, 0, 1); y_w = unifpdf(2, 1, 5); y_lo = unifpdf(0, 1, 5); y_hi = unifpdf(6, 1, 5); y_v = unifpdf(xs, 0, 1); y_b0 = unifpdf(0.5, 1, 0); y_brev = unifpdf(0.5, 5, 1); y_eq = unifpdf(0.5, 1, 1); y_nan = unifpdf(NaN, 0, 1);
comment: Sig: y = unifpdf(x[, a, b]). Continuous uniform PDF on [a, b]; defaults a=0, b=1. y = 1/(b-a) for x in [a,b], else 0. Edges: b<=a -> NaN; NaN x -> NaN; NaN a/b -> 0 (NaN comparisons false, MATLAB convention).
